Tarikh | Episode 1048 | 25 August 2025
# This episode details the 2500-year history of the Hathua Raj in Bihar, originally the Hussepur zamindari.
# The rise of Kalyan Mall and his discendent’s zamindari during the Mughal Period.
# Fateh Sahi, supported by Raja Chait Singh of Benaras, was a formidable guerrilla fighter who never submitted to British rule.
Sahi, however, allied with the British, earning him the title of 'Maharaja Bahadur' and lands confiscated from freedom fighter Babu Kunwar Singh after the 1857 uprising.
